relationships.subject: scalp BoNT-A injection
relationships.evidence_quote: scalp (head) but not lumbar (back) injections of BoNT-A shorten the period of profound depression of spontaneous cortical activity that follows a pinprick-induced cortical spreading depression (CSD)

key_findings: Scalp but not lumbar BoNT-A shortened the neuronal silencing period after CSD without altering CSD occurrence, amplitude, velocity or vascular responses.
Cleaved SNAP25 was found in dural nerve fibers but not in cortex, regardless of whether the BBB was intact or compromised.
